paite: Kumpipa Lemuel thute; anu'n amah athuhilh thu:
heading: Kumpipa Kiang A Thuhilhna

paite: Bang ahia, ka tapa? Bang ahia, Aw ka sul tapa? Huan bang ahia, ka thuchiam tapa?
Na hatna numeite kiang ah pe ke'nla, kumpipate hihsete kiang ah leng na lampite pe sam ke'n.
Kumpipate a ding ahi kei, Aw Lemuel, uain dawn kumpipate a ding ahi kei; Zu khauh koi a om ahia, chih leng lalte a ding ahi sam kei.
Huchi lou in zaw adawn un, dan amangngilh un, gimthuak kuapeuh vaihawmna akaikawi kha ding uh.
Mangthang dia mansa kiang ah zu khauh pia un, kha a haksa sa kiang ah uain.
Dawnsak unla, agentheihna mangngilhsak un, ahaksatna theigige nawn kei hen.
Pau thei lou a ding in na kam ka in, sukgawp a ommi huchibangte tengteng thu ah.
Na kam ka inla, diktak in vai hawm in, gentheite leh tasamte kiang ah vai hawmsak in.
Zi nunhoih kua'n amu dia? Rubi suang tung pek sang in amanphazaw hi.
heading: Zi Nunhoih

paite: Apasal lungtang in amah amuang a, punna taksapna anei kei ding hi.
Adamsung niteng in amah ahihhoih a, ahihse kei.
Samul leh ziza azong a, akhut in kilawptak in nna asem hi.
Sumsinmi longte bang ahi a; gamla a kipan in an ahon tawi a.
Zan lai in leng athou a, a-inkote ding an leh asikhanute kiang ah asep ding apia hi.
Lou angaihtuah a, alei a; akhut a gahte in grephuan abawl hi.
Hatna in akawng agak a, akhutte ahatsak hi.
Asumsinna vante aphatuam chih amu a; zan in akhawnvak amit kei hi.
Akhutte muikhut ah anga a, akhutte mui ah anga hi.
Gentheite lam ah akhut azak a; ahi, tasamte lam asawk hi.
A-inkote ziak in vuk akihta kei a; a-inkote tengteng puan san-au in akithuam uhi.
Puanphah zehoih mantam akibawl a; apuansilh puanmalngat leh sandup ahi.
Kongpite a gam upate lak a apasal atut chiang in, mite' theihtuam in a-om hi.
Puan hoih puansilh abawl a, azuak a; sumsinmi kiang ah kawnggakte apekhia hi.
Hatna leh zahtakna apuansilh ahi; huan hun hong tung ding anuihsan hi.
Pilna in akam aka a; siamna dan alei ah a-om hi.
A-inkote lampi hoihtak in a-en a, huan thadahna tanghou ane kei hi.
Atate athou ua, amah nuamsa achi uhi; apasal in leng, amah aphat hi.
Tanu tampite'n hoihtak in ahih ua, himahleh nang zaw amaute tengteng na khup vek hi, chi in.
Ngaihbanna khemna in adim a, huan kilawmna bangmah lou ahi; himahleh numei TOUPA laudan siam, phat in a-om ding hi.
Akhut a gahte amah pia un; huan kongpite ah athilhihte'n amah phat hen.
